summary: Extend the citation to include the quotation opening in verse 32
rationale: The quotation opening barṯi d-oben-ax l-u=abro d-u=qaḏ̣i corresponds to the supplied 77/32, E, barṯi, d obenax lu abro du qaḏ̣i. The remainder, hiye-ste kət-le māl ġălabe ... lə=k-sənqutu l-noše, is in the cited 77/33. The correct reference must include both verses, rather than replace 33 with 32.
